title: Remote viewing a Guantanamo detainee: five white figures
summary: Lou Elizondo tells of Remote viewing a Guantanamo detainee: five white figures, about an unknown time at The Pentagon, Arlington, Virginia, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and then um lo and behold not too long later a major news media article came out I'm not going to say which one um that detailed this detainee's experience with uh what apparently the detainee perceived as as five white figures over his bed shaking his bed
